values.note: Park's 2027 rate sheet: on-season (April-October) basic $15, electric 30A $27, family basic $22, sewer/electric/water 50A $35; off-season (November-March) $14 / $23 / $20 / $29. The 2026 sheet has the same basic, electric and family rates and no sewer/electric/water line; neither sheet prices the 50A electric-only sites. Water at the sewer/electric/water sites depends on the weather. Rates include sales tax; a family site (two pads) takes one reservation fee.

note: Three loops near Bonne Terre: electric sites 1-63 in the Big River bottom, basic sites 64-110 on a wooded rise, and sites 200-338 (50A electric and full hookup) in open meadow to the west. The river runs along the park's south edge behind a wooded strip, about 45-60 m from the nearest sites. Campers must keep a vehicle on hand for flood evacuation. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $14-15 basic base and electric +12 (2027 = 2026); added full hookup +20, military $2, hookups 30A -> 50A with water/sewer (sites 200-338), 171 sites up to 89 ft, showers/flush/dump/water, 12-month window, walk-up after cutoff, 15-in-30, reservations year-round. Not waterfront kept; pin central among the three loops: kept.
